tail:
VERDICT: CLEAN

BOUNDARY: Isolated points (c isolated in A) satisfy continuity automatically and give ω_f(c)=0 trivially; the proof steps remain valid with δ smaller than the isolation radius. Unbounded f is handled by extended reals; the forward proof forces ω_f(c) finite. No division by zero or empty-set issues occur (A ∩ N_δ(c) always contains c). The use of the triangle inequality in step 2.1 cites L4/lem-of-abs-value; the cited lemma does not explicitly contain the triangle inequality, but the inequality is a standard property of absolute value on ℝ and the gap is closable in seconds. This miscitation does not affect the logical validity of the proof.
